scope: Classify the previously established exact text mismatches using only the existing original ZIP and uploaded JSON; no new download or source research.

method.mainProjectionUsesOriginalCodepointsAfte: NFC is not fed into mark projection: composition of ordinary alif plus Quranic maddah into U+0622 can confuse subsequent letter analysis.
method.waslaFold: U+0671 to U+0627 only, after explicit mark/spacing projection; diagnostic, not production-safe.
method.whitespaceProjection: Collapse whitespace only after removing the explicit projected signs; words are not concatenated in the main partition.
method.residualAlignment: SequenceMatcher(auto junk disabled) on conservative diagnostic views. Flags overlap and are heuristic; no correction or equality inference.
method.exampleOffsetBasis: Unicode codepoint offsets in original decoded strings after removal of U+FEFF only; not byte offsets.

FEFF.interpretation: Embedded format controls in valid UTF-8; not evidence of corrupt transport encoding.

residualObservations.unflaggedResidualInterpretation: All 19 were inspected: the conservative view retains full-lam count differences in night-word forms. This is a spelling/shadda review candidate, not evidence of 19 content errors.

reviewDisposition.needsQualifiedReview: All non-exact strings remain unapproved. Even pairs equal after lossy diagnostic views may differ in shadda, vowels, pause signs, letter annotations or token boundaries. Residual count is a workload category, not a count of Quran errors.
reviewDisposition.wordTokenMapping: Do not derive app word/token IDs by pairing whitespace-split positions across these two corpora.

whitespaceTokenObservations.method: Count whitespace-separated nonempty tokens after removing FEFF and the explicit diagnostic projected signs only; this is not an approved Quran word segmentation or alignment.
